scripts.build: rm -rf build && diff src/external/cctv.worker.orig.js src/external/cctv.worker.js -u | sed '1,2s/\t.*//' >src/external/cctv.worker.diff; npx tsc && mkdir build/external && cp src/external/cctv.worker.js build/external
scripts.bundle: rm -rf build/final && npx esbuild src/cli/main.ts src/worker/worker.ts --sourcemap=linked --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=build/final/ && cd build/final && mv cli/* worker/* . && rmdir cli worker && tar zcvf ../final.tar.gz . && zip -r ../final.zip .
scripts.bundle-web: rm -rf build/final-web && npx esbuild src/web/web-decrypt-script.ts src/worker/worker.ts --sourcemap=linked --bundle --format=esm --outdir=build/final-web/ --external:node:*
scripts.cp-web: rm -rf ../cctv-h5e-decrypt-web/js && mkdir -p ../cctv-h5e-decrypt-web/js/external && cp -r build/final-web/* ../cctv-h5e-decrypt-web/js/ && cp src/external/cctv.worker.js ../cctv-h5e-decrypt-web/js/external/ && cp decrypter.html ../cctv-h5e-decrypt-web/index.html
scripts.sync-latest-worker: TMP=$(mktemp) && curl -qfsS https://player.cntv.cn/h5vod/cctv.worker.js | npx js-beautify -n >$TMP && if cmp "$TMP" src/external/cctv.worker.orig.js; then rm -f $TMP; else mv -f "$TMP" src/external/cctv.worker.orig.js && echo need to update cctv.worker.js; fi
